# aidd-write

Apply focused writing, editing, review, and scoring guidance without taking
ownership of repository delivery operations.

## Why

Use this skill when prose must be clear, purposeful, audience-aware, and
concise while preserving the author's intended voice.

## Commands

```text
/aidd-write <prompt> <context> <goal> <criteria>
/aidd-write review <writing>
/aidd-write edit <writing> [review]
/aidd-write score <writing>
```

The skill returns writing guidance or revised content. It does not commit,
push, manage planning records, or declare delivery readiness.
